questions.question: What are your top three health goals right now?
questions.value: Become pain-free by healing right-side injuries (partial TFCC tear, partial SLAP tear, golfer’s elbow); Reach optimal weight from 70 kg to 68 kg and regain a visible six-pack; Improve energy and sleep consistency while reducing daytime sleepiness

questions.question: Why do YOU think these goals are pending?
questions.value: These health goals are still pending because healing my joints has been a long-term process, although I feel like I’m about 95% recovered now. My weight goal fell behind mostly because I was traveling and not paying close enough attention to what I was eating. My sleep and energy goal is still a work in progress because I find it hard to stay consistent with sleep when there is always something going on.
